name: 3/4 Sit-Up
setup: Set up on the floor, a bench or the bar the variation names, lower back steady.
cues: Curl the belt buckle toward your ribs on a slow, smooth path.
Breathe out as you curl.
Lower slow until you are back at the start.

faults.fault: Yanking on the head or swinging the legs
faults.fix: Move on a slow two-count; hands light behind the ears or across the chest.

faults.fault: Lower back arching off the floor
faults.fix: Shorten the range so the lower back stays heavy on the floor.

name: Ab Roller
setup: Kneel (or stand, advanced) with the hands on the wheel, bar or straps under the shoulders.
cues: Brace for a light punch, then roll the wheel out only as far as the line holds.
Pull the wheel back toward the start with the arms long, smooth and slow.
Keep the belt buckle tucked toward your chin.

faults.fault: Lower back sagging toward the floor
faults.fix: Roll out less and keep the belt buckle tucked.

faults.fault: Hips leading the return
faults.fix: Pull the wheel back on the same path, long arms first, hips following.

cautions: Pick the easier version if the range or the load stops being smooth.

name: Advanced Kettlebell Windmill
setup: Start light: hold the kettlebell with a straight wrist, the arm long and stacked over the shoulder where the move is overhead.
cues: Keep your eyes on the bell and the knuckles pointing at the ceiling.
Move slow and smooth: every position should be one you could pause in.
Push the floor away with the free hand or foot as you rise.

faults.fault: Bell drifting off the stack
faults.fix: Keep the knuckles pointing straight at the ceiling the whole time.

faults.fault: Rushing between positions
faults.fix: Pause for a count in each position before the next one.

cautions: Needs comfortable overhead range: if the bar or bell drifts forward, press at an angle (landmine) instead.

faults.fix: Pause for a count in each position before the next one.

cautions: Needs comfortable overhead range: if the bar or bell drifts forward, press at an angle (landmine) instead.
